import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from decimal import Decimal

WM_DELAY = timedelta(seconds=30)   # bounded out-of-orderness
WIN      = timedelta(minutes=1)    # tumbling event-time window
ALLOWED_LATENESS = timedelta(0)    # keep separate from the watermark delay

records = [
    (1,  "evt-003", "P3", "7.25",   "2025-01-01T00:02:00Z"),
    (2,  "evt-001", "P1", "10.00",  "2025-01-01T00:00:30Z"),
    (3,  "evt-007", "P1", "-10.00", "2025-01-01T00:06:00Z"),
    (4,  "evt-002", "P2", "25.50",  "2025-01-01T00:01:15Z"),
    (5,  "evt-005", "P2", "4.99",   "2025-01-01T00:04:05Z"),
    (6,  "evt-001", "P1", "10.00",  "2025-01-01T00:00:30Z"),   # duplicate
    (7,  "evt-004", "P1", "12.00",  "2025-01-01T00:03:20Z"),
    (8,  "evt-010", "P3", "21.10",  "2025-01-01T00:08:55Z"),
    (9,  "evt-006", "P3", "8.75",   "2025-01-01T00:05:10Z"),
    (10, "evt-009", "P3", "3.50",   "2025-01-01T00:07:30Z"),
    (11, "evt-011", "P2", "6.40",   "2025-01-01T00:09:40Z"),
    (12, "evt-008", "P2", "15.00",  "2025-01-01T00:06:45Z"),
]

def ts(s):
    return datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace("Z", "+00:00")).replace(tzinfo=None)

raw = pd.DataFrame(records, columns=["arrival", "event_id", "product_id", "revenue", "t"])
raw["event_time"] = raw["t"].map(ts)
raw["revenue"]    = raw["revenue"].map(Decimal)
raw = raw.drop(columns="t").sort_values("arrival").reset_index(drop=True)

# ---- pass 1: watermark ladder (monotonically non-decreasing) ----
rows, max_et = [], None
for r in raw.itertuples():
    et = r.event_time
    wm_before = None if max_et is None else max_et - WM_DELAY   # watermark in force on arrival
    max_et = et if max_et is None else max(max_et, et)
    wm_after = max_et - WM_DELAY
    late = wm_before is not None and et < wm_before
    rows.append(dict(arrival=r.arrival, event_id=r.event_id, product_id=r.product_id,
                     revenue=r.revenue, event_time=et, wm_before=wm_before, wm_after=wm_after,
                     max_et=max_et, status="LATE" if late else "on-time",
                     late_by_s=int((wm_before - et).total_seconds()) if late else 0,
                     window=et.replace(second=0, microsecond=0)))
ev = pd.DataFrame(rows)

# ---- pass 2: first arrival at which each window's watermark closes it ----
fires = {}
for w in sorted(ev.window.unique()):
    we = w + WIN
    hit = [a for a, wm in zip(ev.arrival, ev.wm_after) if wm >= we]
    fires[w] = min(hit) if hit else None
ev["win_fire_arr"] = ev.window.map(fires)
ev["late_for_closed_window"] = ev.apply(
    lambda r: r.win_fire_arr is not None and r.arrival > r.win_fire_arr, axis=1)

h = lambda t: "—" if t is None else t.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
show = ev.assign(
    event_time=ev.event_time.dt.strftime("%H:%M:%S"),
    wm_before=ev.wm_before.map(h), wm_after=ev.wm_after.map(h),
    max_et=ev.max_et.dt.strftime("%H:%M:%S"),
    window=ev.window.dt.strftime("%H:%M"),
    win_fire_arr=ev.win_fire_arr.fillna("end-of-input"),
)[["arrival","event_id","product_id","event_time","max_et","wm_before","wm_after",
   "status","late_by_s","window","win_fire_arr","late_for_closed_window"]]
print(show.to_string(index=False))

print(f"\nfinal watermark      : {h(ev.wm_after.iloc[-1])}  "
      f"(max event_time {h(ev.max_et.iloc[-1])} - 30s)")
print(f"on-time / late       : {(ev.status=='on-time').sum()} / {(ev.status=='LATE').sum()}")
print(f"late vs closed window: {ev.late_for_closed_window.sum()} of {len(ev)}")
print(f"unflushed window     : [00:09, 00:10) needs WM >= 00:10:00 — only flushed at end-of-input")
